<title
    level="1"
    right="Feat 6"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Toppling Transformation](/Feats.aspx?ID=5403) <actions string="Reaction" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Druid" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=583" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 56

</column>

---

You use your body's expansion as leverage to displace a nearby creature. You attempt to [Shove](/Actions.aspx?ID=2380) or [Trip](/Actions.aspx?ID=2382) an adjacent creature. For the purposes of determining what size creature you can affect, use your final size after the triggering effect.
name: Toppling Transformation
